epics.title: Slice one: migrate the memory
epics.rationale: Proposed as one epic and approved. The platform stories and the migration stories are one system, neither half ships alone, and the epic's definition of done is the empty diff, which needs every story. Risk profile is the one test that argued for a split, and it would have produced two epics that must both finish before either is useful.

tasks.title: Provision PostgreSQL with pgvector on amaterasu
Install PostgreSQL 18 and pgvector from PGDG
tasks.implementedBy: scripts/provision-amaterasu.sh, run by Shane on 26 August 2026

docImpact.note: postgresql-18 18.6 and postgresql-18-pgvector 0.8.6 from PGDG for noble, under systemd and enabled at boot. Verified live on 26 August 2026.

tasks.title: Create the kpa role and the two databases
tasks.implementedBy: scripts/provision-amaterasu.sh, run by Shane on 26 August 2026

docImpact.note: kpa role is LOGIN, NOSUPERUSER, NOCREATEROLE and owns both kpa and kpa_dev. No kpa_ro role, by the PRD's decision: ADR-0003 has KPA reading nabium, not the reverse.

tasks.title: Tune for the box, bind to the LAN, and enable TLS
tasks.implementedBy: scripts/provision-amaterasu.sh, run by Shane on 26 August 2026

docImpact.note: listen_addresses is localhost plus the LAN address, never 0.0.0.0. Two hostssl lines for 192.168.20.0/24 with scram-sha-256, so a client offering no TLS is refused. sslmode=require, not verify-full.
Twelve settings in conf.d/kpa.conf, scaled from nabium's postgres-tuning.md rather than copied, because that runbook targets a 32 GB host and amaterasu holds 7.6 GB shared with NFS.

tasks.title: Copy the backup runbook and follow it once with a restore

docImpact.note: Dumps run on amaterasu, not the Mac: pg_dump 17.11 refuses the 18.6 server. Two dumps, because pg_dump -Fc emits no CREATE DATABASE and no roles at all.
The 26 August drill's count step failed on a lost quote escape, and both sides were zero anyway because kpa holds no objects. The script is fixed; the drill is worth repeating after KPA-4 and KPA-5.
